name: Azure Container Apps

evidence.paas: 03: fully managed serverless container hosting; Microsoft runs the platform and the customer supplies images

line: Run containerized applications on managed serverless infrastructure.

cells.regions: East US example; many Azure regions

work.math: At 0.25 vCPU and 0.5 GiB, the charge is $0.0000075 per replica-second (one copy of the app running for one second) above 720,000, and $0 below that. Startup and scale-in time count.
1 vCPU and 2 GiB for 730 hours. This range runs from idle to active, after unused monthly grants. Extra copies started during rollouts are not included.
The small app API range of $22.03–$73.44, plus $133.62 for PostgreSQL compute and 32 GiB of storage. Backup excess, 10 GB of traffic and extra copies during rollouts are unknown.
